statements-group.name: TPollVote.check
statements-group.statement: -- Detect invalid tie values in the TPollVote table -- Should return 0 rows in a consistent system. SELECT PV.PollVoteK,PV.FTie AS Invalid_FTie_Value FROM TPollVote PV LEFT JOIN TPollTie PT ON PV.FTie = PT.PollTieK WHERE PV.FTie IS NOT NULL AND PT.PollTieK IS NULL

-- Detect multiple ties created from the same IP address for the same poll -- Should return 0 rows in a consistent system. SELECT PollK, FIp, COUNT(*) AS tie_count, GROUP_CONCAT(PollTieK) AS PollTieKs, MIN(CreateD) AS first_tie, MAX(CreateD) AS last_tie FROM TPollTie WHERE FIp IS NOT NULL GROUP BY PollK, FIp HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY tie_count DESC

statements-group.name: TPollVote.count

statement.name: count_for_poll
statement.description: Select count of votes and some keys for selected poll

statements-group.statement: -- Select count of votes and some keys for selected poll SELECT (SELECT P_.FName FROM TPoll P_ WHERE P_.PollK = PQ_.PollK) AS PollName, hex(PQ_.PollK), PQ_.FName ,hex(PV_.PollAnswerK), COUNT(PV_.PollVoteK) FROM TPollQuestion PQ_ INNER JOIN TPollAnswer PA_ ON PQ_.PollQuestionK = PA_.PollQuestionK INNER JOIN TPollVote PV_ ON PA_.PollAnswerK = PV_.PollAnswerK -- WHERE PQ_.PollK = X'82D5B2EB5051AEF825A34600268C3DF9' GROUP BY PV_.PollAnswerK

statement.name: count_for_poll
statement.description: Count of counts of votes based on selected answers

statements-group.statement: -- Count of counts of votes based on selected answers SELECT hex(PV_.PollAnswerK), COUNT(PV_.PollVoteK) FROM TPollQuestion PQ_ INNER JOIN TPollAnswer PA_ ON PQ_.PollQuestionK = PA_.PollQuestionK INNER JOIN TPollVote PV_ ON PA_.PollAnswerK = PV_.PollAnswerK WHERE PQ_.PollK = X'82D5B2EB5051AEF825A34600268C3DF9' AND PV_.FTie IN (SELECT FTie FROM TPollVote WHERE PollAnswerK IN( X'EA21D327AB5F42DF4FAB0797EFB39FCE') ) GROUP BY PV_.PollAnswerK
